xsitk_huang_thresh — 2D extra op

• Data kinds: image → region

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "xsitk_huang_thresh", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

Usage

Binarization by Huang's fuzzy entropy method (SimpleITK `HuangThreshold`). Chooses the threshold that minimizes the ambiguity (fuzzy entropy) of the foreground/background viewed as a fuzzy set.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

`a はヒストグラムのビン数(64〜256)を振る。b` は未使用。xsitk_maxentropy_thresh・xsitk_moments_thresh の姉妹 op。
